#C236196003Rin#CDEF boldly glares at the intruders.

Why did you invite Darling and I
to this slimy #C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF?
What is your goal?
My objective? Obviously because it's necessary.

Hehe. That's the #C236196003Rin#CDEF I know.
No, maybe I should be calling you Queen?
You're the one who will obtain the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF.

Why is #C236196003Rin#CDEF so obsessed about being "Queen," I wonder.
Don't girls long to be princesses?
We defeated her…!

…ah…
I… didn't… lose…
I can… still… fight…!

Red drops fall from the tip of #C236196003Lancer#CDEF's spear.
Drip. Drip.
That's #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's blood…
If a Servant vanishes, the Master, too―――

I, as Queen, decide the rules.
Rejoice, #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.
You still have some utility.
Utility…?

…after that:
Heaven knows when I'll wake up again―――

Ugh… mm――― Ow, my head…
What's going on? Why am I laying here?

Holding #C236196003Rin#CDEF in my arms, I felt a warm heat from her body.
Unlike #C236196003Sakura#CDEF, I don't have a method for measuring someone's
vitals, but from this alone I could tell that she was alright.

Huh… Who is this red #C236196003Lancer#CDEF…?
I can remember her face, but other than that,
nothing else.

Eh… Hold―wait,
wait, wait, WAAAAIITT!
I say with a smile.

Please wait a moment.
I'll come and meet you there.
Well, actually―――

#C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF!
You said I need to self-reflect,
but what exactly is wrong with me?
…that's right.

W-what's so bad about that!?
It might not be cute, but…

Money is… yeah, one's future!
To do research, wage war, date―you need money,
don't you?

Wouldn't you rather have two premium seats at
the movies than watch videos on the web in your
room? "Money is love power," right?
Well, searching around for hidden-gem videos sounds fun, too.

W-who said it would be us two!?
I wasn't thinking that any movie might be
interesting if I went to see it with you!
Temptation
This is not the truth.
#C236196003Rin#CDEF's final secret is―――

That's right, didn't I say I was the queen?
It's not too late.
Come on, call me "queen."

Very interesting.
I ask her how exactly I can get out of here.

W-well…
You can leave once you satisfy me!
Probably, I'm sure, I think!

Sh-shut up, shut up, SHUT UP!
I can't be doing that,
I can't give away control…

This isn't going to work.
She's being too hard on herself and now wants an escape route.
I need to tell it to her straight.
I did.
However, to be exact, she's a "capitalist bitch."
Damn, I messed up…!
Kya……!?

Ahh, but I'm starting to feel really relaxed…
Why…? …am I, really a bitch…?

You probably don't get me because I'm far
superior, but I act by thinking one step ahead!

I'm perfect!
I have to be!

I can't afford to complain,
not a single gripe…!

―――!
T-that's fine with me.
Thanks, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF!

Just let me take all the responsibility!
I'll be meticulous, elegant, strict―and I'll
squeeze your wallet dry!
…I messed up.
Hyah…!

S-squeal? Squeal…
I'm not squealing!
I'm just clearly stating the obvious!
No one can see the "real #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF," anyway.

Knowing this, #C236196003Rin#CDEF acts strict to everyone,
readying herself to be hated by others.

Huh? Really?
#C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF, you don't think YOU'RE cute?
This means I can do with you as I please, right?
Trying to beat #C236196003Rin#CDEF with logic won't free her…!
HyaaaaAaahhhhh!

Stop it… Enough, please, stop…
I'll do what you say…
I'll do whatever you say…
…that's a given.

However, still, #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF is the one here
insisting on having her own way.
E-even if you say that, even if you say that…!
It's obvious.
Why is #C236196003Rin#CDEF so hard on people?
Ah―― Aah! Aaa-aah…!

Whatever you say now is pointless.
Your words have no effect here in my world.

Now you'll never destroy this world.
And I can now never be freed.
The world is growing dark…

…now there's no way out.
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF's words failed to reach her―――
Where―――am I?
Could I be――inside that sculpture of #C236196003Rin#CDEF…?
The part that's become a stagnant, muddied "#ROFS0001#RUBS    dress#RUBErestraint#REND."
No need.

Technically, I may actually be speechless,
but I'm feeling strangely relaxed.

Wh-what did you say…!?
Defeat? Me!? Even though I captured you!?

…!
I-I was hoping for the same! Bring it on!
I won't lose to you, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF!

I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.

Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

You actually came. You don't get tired of
stealing looks at people's secrets, stomping
all the way into the depths of their mind.

If this place had any laws, you'd get prison
and manual labor for eternity, but――

Be grateful this is the inside of my mind.
I'm lenient. I'll let this petty insult,
this child's play, slide.

This is the #C236196003Rin#CDEF I remember.
Different from the mentally and emotionally
unstable #C236196003Rin#CDEF up until now.

Brimming with confidence, vigilant of her surroundings,
never letting herself get provoked…
There's no doubt: that's the real #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF!―――

A sensible #C236196003Rin#CDEF finally shows up. Though there is
not much to discuss at this point, let us try
asking her a few things.

Why have you dragged my Praetor to the
#C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF? I know you are aiming
for something, #C236196003Rin#CDEF!

It looks like it's her Real Mind this time.
Let's ask her a few things before we fight.

Why did you summon us to the #C000246204Far Side of
the Moon#CDEF? What's your goal, #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF?

Lenient, she says. Well then,
before we do this, let's take a moment
to clear up a few uncertainties.

This should be better than speaking with
a mere clone. #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, was there not
something you wanted to ask?

Such as, why were you dropped into the #C000246204Far Side
of the Moon#CDEF? Or, this woman who calls herself
Queen of the Moon―what is her objective?

You're all worker ants who'll serve me.
Slaves forced to labor for me until their last
breath, here on the #C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF.
#C236196003Rin#CDEF said it as if it was obvious.

It's no different than bleeding out the NPCs
and Masters of their blood in that torture chamber.

…until now, I would avert my eyes,
thinking to myself, "This isn't the real #C236196003Rin#CDEF."
But that was a mistake.

Whether she's real or fake,
any #C236196003Rin#CDEF that says those kinds of things
deserves a hard slap in the face…!

Look at that――
There's no more hesitation in your eyes.
It wouldn't be interesting otherwise.

I'm going to work you all to the bone
expanding this Labyrinth. Then I'll reach the
#C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF's Core and obtain the whole system.

Great power must only be managed by the chosen.
Those of a lineage, entrusted with
the responsibility of governance: nobles.

Well, honestly speaking, it's a big pain in
the neck, and I personally want to destroy it…
but for some reason, I HAVE to control it!

Right. You two should follow #C236196003Lancer#CDEF's example
and call me Queen instead of #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF.
Do that, and I'll spare your life.

Go on, say it. In a loud voice,
as if you were singing my praises.
This is your last chance, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF!

……#C236196003Rin#CDEF looks down on me. She appears composed,
but as a matter of fact, her eyes are darting about.
I should say―――
Your Majesty, please calm yourself.
Your Majesty, have you not been deceived?
So how are you liking that mini-skirt?

I am calm!
I'm calmer and more tranquil than the sea!
That reply kinda pisses me off!

Deceived… Th-there's no way that could happen!
I'm the absolute #C000246204Queen of the Moon#CDEF, you know!

I said call me QUEEEEN! Are you a monster!?
If you at least did as I say in the end,
I wouldn't have to punish you, you know!?
…this discussion really is going nowhere.

All that's left now is to decide who wins and loses by force.
But… there's one last thing I want to confirm.

Eh? How stupid, of course I want to be a Queen
instead of a princess. After all, princesses
can't use the country's budget as they like.
―――Alright. Let's take her down.

I think that's what's best for the world,
the people, and the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF…!

That's the spirit! However, #C236196003Rin#CDEF―a nation's
treasury belongs to the people and the future.
No one, even a queen, may misappropriate it.

I'll warn you: that way of thinking will only
lead to ruin. Well, I DID use my treasury
whimsically, though!

Good grief. If there's no bread, then "let them
eat cake." You know the name of the queen who
made that gaffe?

#C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF. I bear you no ill will,
but this a good opportunity to reform that
unruly act of yours, here and now!

Ah! A new type of beautiful courtesan…!
I seeee. You may be an honest girl, but being
greedy about money ruins a country, no?

Nothing ever goes as planned, and even with
finishing touches, jewels still have flaws.
For #C236196003Rin#CDEF's sake, we cleanse her heart of evil!

Well! Now we're in agreement, mongrel!
You truly are the woman I judged you to be.
You understand how to use wealth!

However―――THAT is why I cannot ignore it.
Your principles are based on self-pleasure. You
make a very woman-like, emotional argument.

Kings rule over wealth with their ambition.
Queens consume wealth through their#RUBS placentas#RUBE wombs#REND.
By my hand, I will show you the difference!

The heck, now I look like the bad guy…!
Fine. Now that it's come to this,
let's see who's right and who's wrong!

Let's do this, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF! We'll prove to them
that we're the chosen nobles!

Ugh… What's with this focused intent #[he][she]# 
has…!? #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF is different than usual―
#[H-he][Sh-she]#'s kind of cool, maybe…

Hey, what am I saying!?
I can't let my guard down.
I need to reject #[him][her]# as hard as I can.
First, let's review.

#C236196003Rin#CDEF wants to collect more wealth… more cash than
she really needs.

She keeps saying that the only thing she believes in is money.
What's that called, again?
Money Worship
Immorality Worship

I don't have any interests like THAT! I never
said that I enjoy seeing people suffer and
stuff! I mean, that's just evil. Plain evil.

I messed up because it sounded kind of similar.
The right answer is―――
Going to the movies with #C236196003Rin#CDEF, huh…
That might be fun to do once we get out of here.
This is―what is it called―obviously…
Templation (Overly Self-conscious)

Hee hee… So you finally realized
how charming I am.

I don't remember seducing you, but just me
standing here makes you weak in the knees…
It's scary how prominent of a character I am.

Sure, I think she would be very captivating 
if she would just stay quiet.

The mini skirt, the leather boots―
Sometimes, even I think it's a bit much.
But unfortunately, this wasn't the right choice.
The right answer is―――

No, that's not how it is at all.
Promises, tsunderes――
Don't decide who people are for them!

All I'm doing is what I want to do!
I decide for myself, I prepare myself, I take
responsibility… What's wrong with that!?

It's everyone's duty to be the one who
dominates themselves. Abandoning that duty
just means being lazy.

To be human
is to sometimes want to slack off.
                                    -#C236196003#NICK#CDEF

That's why she jumps from extreme to extreme,
placing herself in positions that contradict
who she truly is―――
She possesses a desire that seems to seek taboo.
Submission Desire
Domination Desire

Do so, and I'm fine with letting
you leave this place.

That was the wrong choice.
I mustn't coddle #C236196003Rin#CDEF.
The right answer is―――

How can my decisions, impressions, actions,
emotions―even one gram of blood, one teardrop
from my head to my toes NOT belong to me――

No matter how sweet it would be to do so, I
would lose my dignity. …no, I wouldn't even be
human anymore, so why would I care…?

It's all a fleeting trick of her imagination.
Nothing more than taboo.

Wah………!!!!?
W-w-why are you yelling all of a sudden!??
And "bitch," you called me a "bitch"!??

………#C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.
I think you just said the worst word there is
right to the bitch's face. Maybe I misheard?

That's not better. Why would that be better?
Also, I'm seriously disappointed in you.

You're going to look at these slender,
beautiful legs and call me a pig?
You really have no eye for these things.

Anything a person like you says to me will
tick me off. Call me a pig, or a hippo,
or whatever you want.

Although―――in exchange, I'll kill you.
I WILL kill you. I will kill you,
and it will be messy, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF…!
I need to attack with confidence until the end!

I-I don't know anything about that!
I'm just a logical, elegant money-worshipper,
not some bitch…

You're wrong, you're WRONG! Why do I feel
so relieved about getting scolded!?
This isn't―this isn't me!

N-no! You're wrong, you're definitely wrong!
I'm always logical!

I accidentally made her self-confidence resurface.
This won't work. She's going to revert
back into the troublesome queen she was before.

Why do you keep saying horrible things to me!?
Why! Why won't you look at the real me!?

"What I'm saying isn't the same as what I'm doing.
 Still, please understand my inner thoughts―――"

She's acting like a spoiled brat.
The #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF I knew never whined like that.
That what's so kind and beautiful about #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF.
But what about right now?

She keeps pushing only HER thoughts,
and when confronted, she bawls.

How can anyone properly think about their future like that?
Ridiculous.
Right now, all #C236196003Rin#CDEF is thinking about is herself!

L-listen―――
Even I want to take it easy once in a while…
I wanted to be honest with myself…!

What!? What's wrong with that!?
It's fine to think about your own needs!
It's natural to think that you're the cutest!

Ohhh, well then we've got great chemistry☆
Me, the cute one, and you, the whatever one.

Hee hee hee… and I'll be paying you back
big time for that verbal lashing you gave me.

Maaan, still, you surprised me there. I had no
idea there was actually a hypocrite around here
who "values others above themselves."
Damn! This will ruin everything!
Uhh, the right answer is―――

I don't want to take responsibility… I won't
become honest that way… With responsibility,
I can't say what I want to say…!

Despite bearing both the responsibility of guiding people
AND being hated by people, #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF still has her pride.

I think I'm cute. I realized that it's
only natural! At this point, what does it
matter what's right or wrong―――

It's natural to think, "I'm the cutest."
But that's nothing to be ashamed of.

If there's anything to actually be embarrassed about,
it's people who think, "only I'm cute."

It's because she can't ignore the potential
in the person she's looking at.

Okay… That's fine, then…
This is who I am…

Even though I'm actually weak,
I try my best to look tough.
I'll look tough to the very end―that's me…

Isn't that right? That's who #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF is.
These are my beliefs,
the beliefs I like the most―――

Ahh… It feels good,
but it's embarrassing…
I can't believe that I'm fully exposed.

But this is fine, right…?
The one thing I can't change is who I am
deep down… I'm fine with this―――

You'll probably forget this once you leave here,
but I'm grateful.
Thank you for setting me free, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

…yeah. Just let me say this one last thing:
let me give you one good smack after this.

Nope, no more chances.
You'll be saying no more. Hey, just what have
you been seeing in me this whole time?

Understand? Regardless of whatever proverb
you whip out, you won't be making a single
ripple of discord in my mind.

―――Dead end. You should've software updated
your head with some common sense
before you went calling people "dogs."
It's proof that #C236196003Rin#CDEF's mind has been completely closed off.

Just now, the world completely changed.
#C236196003Rin#CDEF isn't here. #C236196003#SVT#CDEF isn't here.
I don't even feel any sense of reality.

Yeah. Even your Servant can't help you here.
It's a one-on-one in a secret room―
between you and the genuine article, me.

Or maybe I should say "prison."
Sorry, but no exit here. This is my mind.
You're trapped in here for life.
I see… This is the center of #C236196003Rin#CDEF's mind.

…y-you're pretty relaxed. No one's coming
to rescue you, you know? There's no exit,
you know? Aren't you gonna panic?

Because―――if this is the center of her mind,
all I have to do is defeat #C236196003Rin#CDEF with words.

Well, rather than defeat―I mean physically punish.
I don't know the reason why, but #C236196003Rin#CDEF injured many NPCs
and did a number on me as well.

Time for some retribution.
Since this is #C236196003Rin#CDEF's mind, there's nowhere she can run…!

I'll completely refute anything you say to me!
Then I'll turn the tables on you…!
The stagnation in her mind turned into thorns to repel me.

…don't worry, I have enough of a shot at winning.
I'll make good use of the #C000246204SGs#CDEF that I've collected
up until now and make #C236196003Rin#CDEF repent…!
I rush over to #C236196003Rin#CDEF and help her sit up.

Huh―#C236196003#NICK#CDEF…?
…why am I… If I recall correctly,
I contracted with that red #C236196003Lancer#CDEF…

#C236196003#NICK#CDEF, what's up with me?
And hey, where are we?
What happened up until now?
#C236196003Rin#CDEF seems to have forgotten about #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.

Since hiding things would make her angry somewhere down the line,
I explained everything that happened up until now.

Particularly, about how she declared herself Queen,
and about the Money-Is-Power system, in detail.

What? Are you telling me none of that
was just a dream!? I didn't actually do
all those crazy things, right!?

Yes, you did them. You were quite different
than usual, #C236196003Rin#CDEF. Your desires were laid bare.
